<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

On gfx950 with `--kv-cache-dtype fp8` and the ROCM_AITER_FA backend, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B now prepares Q/K/V in FP8 in one fused kernel (Q/K RMSNorm, partial RoPE, gate extraction and FP8 quantization), and the backend consumes them directly for prefill and chunked-prefill attention. Decode keeps the existing paged-attention path. There is no new flag: the path is scoped to the one validated checkpoint by its exact text config, and every other model, KV cache dtype and platform runs as before.

The kernel is `fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant` from [ROCm/aiter#5002](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5002) (merged), released in AITER v0.1.25. vLLM `main` pins that release since [#61697](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61697).

Not a duplicate: searched open PRs for "prequantized FP8 attention ROCm", "fp8 qkv aiter fmha" and "fused qk norm rope gate fp8". [#58713](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58713) is stacked on this PR and replaces the chunked context loop with one paged-prefix call; [#53989](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53989) enables the BF16 fused QK-norm+RoPE+gate kernel on XPU.

## Claims

- 60K input / 600 output on Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4, TP8 MI355X: output throughput +4.2% at c1, +11.1% at c4, +9.6% at c8. <TODO: replace with the re-measurement on nightly-3f1bcfd8>
- 128K input / 1K output: +11.3% at c1, +19.4% at c4; mean TTFT −23.0% at c1 and −19.1% at c4. <TODO: same>
- Flat at 1K/1K c16 and 8K/1K c8: short prompts spend little time in prefill attention, and decode does not take the new path.
- No directional accuracy change on GSM8K and GPQA Diamond with an FP8 KV cache. <TODO: flip counts and McNemar p>
- Scoped: any other model, a BF16 KV cache, or another GPU keeps the existing BF16 attention path.

## Validation

**Unit tests.** One MI355X (gfx950), `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-3f1bcfd82bb2e93fcd364fc7a5491718453a77e2` (AITER 0.1.25) with this PR's `vllm/` diff applied, tests from the PR head <TODO: sha>, all files in one pytest process: <TODO: counts from the queued run>.

```bash
python -m pytest -v \
  tests/model_executor/layers/test_attention_prequantized_qkv.py \
  tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant.py \
  tests/model_executor/layers/test_rocm_aiter_prequantized_qkv.py \
  tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_5_quantization.py \
  tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa.py \
  tests/kernels/test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate.py \
  tests/compile/test_config.py
```

| File | Result | Fails if |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test_attention_prequantized_qkv.py` | <TODO> | the `PrequantizedQKV` bundle loses a tensor or its identity on the way through `unified_attention`, or the path without it changes |
| `test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant.py` | <TODO> | the path reaches a Qwen3.5-class checkpoint other than Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B; the FP8 preparation op is used outside the scheduler limits it was sized for, is marked CUDA-graph safe when it reads attention metadata, or pure decode stops falling back to BF16 |
| `test_rocm_aiter_prequantized_qkv.py` | <TODO> | the AITER backend accepts prequantized Q/K/V with a non-FP8 KV cache, drops or mis-slices the descales in a mixed batch, or uses FP8 Q/K/V for pure decode |
| `test_qwen3_5_quantization.py` | <TODO> | the Qwen3.5 wrapper stops forwarding `max_num_seqs`, which sizes the preparation workspace |
| `test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate.py` | <TODO> | the BF16 fused kernel stops writing into caller-provided output buffers |
| `test_config.py` | <TODO> | the FP8 preparation op stops being a piecewise CUDA graph split point; it reads runtime attention metadata and cannot be captured |

`tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa.py` is unchanged and covers the existing gather and FMHA paths.

**Kernel evidence.** TP8 traces at 60K/600 c4, FP8 KV cache.

| Attention in a chunked prefill | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Causal, within the current chunk | BF16 FMHA | `fmha_fwd_hd256_fp8_causal_group_gfx950` |
| Current chunk over cached K/V | FP8 cache dequantized to BF16 + BF16 FMHA | FP8 cache copied as is + `fmha_fwd_hd256_fp8_group_gfx950` |
| Combine | `merge_attn_states` | `merge_attn_states` |

**End to end.** 8× MI355X, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MoE MXFP4, TP8, `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA`, max-num-batched-tokens 8192, prefix caching off, FP8 KV cache. Before is the stock nightly, after is the same nightly with this PR; nothing else differs. TODO


**Accuracy.** FP8 KV cache, same seed per pair; GPQA Diamond with temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, seed 42, max_tokens 100000.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GSM8K | <TODO> | <TODO> | <TODO> |
| GPQA Diamond | <TODO> | <TODO> | <TODO> |

**Reproduce:** the same command on the stock nightly and on this branch.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1 \
vllm serve amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 131072 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --compilation-config '{"pass_config":{"enable_qk_norm_rope_fusion":true}}'

vllm bench serve --model <model> --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 61440 --random-output-len 600 --max-concurrency 4 --num-prompts <N>

evalscope eval --model <served-name> --api-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions \
  --api-key EMPTY --eval-type openai_api --datasets gpqa_diamond --eval-batch-size 4 \
  --generation-config '{"max_tokens":100000,"temperature":1.0,"top_p":0.95,"seed":42,"timeout":7200}' \
  --timeout 7200
```

## Details

Before this PR, Qwen3.8 runs Q/K normalization, partial RoPE and gate extraction into BF16, and a chunked prefill makes two BF16 attention calls: causal attention within the chunk, then the chunk's queries over the cached K/V, which is first dequantized from the FP8 cache into a BF16 workspace. `merge_attn_states` combines the two.

With this PR, one AITER kernel does the normalization, RoPE, gate extraction and FP8 quantization, and writes FP8 Q/K/V plus their descales. They travel to the backend as a `PrequantizedQKV` bundle, a backend-neutral argument of `unified_attention` that backends without support reject. The AITER FA backend runs the causal call on the FP8 tensors, and for the context call it copies the FP8 cache into an FP8 workspace without dequantizing it. Pure decode ignores the bundle and keeps the paged-attention kernel, since decode attention is bandwidth bound on the KV cache and gains nothing from FP8 queries.

**There is no env flag to turn this on/off**. FP8 attention changes numerics, so instead of an opt-in the path is scoped to what was validated:

- **The model.** `_is_qwen38_2p4t_a95b` matches the Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B text config exactly (hidden size, layer count, heads, KV heads, head dim, experts). Qwen3.8 loads through the Qwen3.5 classes, and Qwen3.8-27B has the same attention geometry as Qwen3.5-27B, so the architecture name cannot tell the models apart.
- **The KV cache.** Only an FP8 KV cache: a user who picked it has already accepted FP8 precision for K/V. With a BF16 cache the model keeps BF16 attention.
- **The kernel.** gfx950, ROCM_AITER_FA, head size 256, a query-to-KV head ratio of 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16, full causal attention without sinks or soft cap, a text-only model and `max_num_seqs` ≤ 256.

**Limitations and CI gaps.**

- Measured on gfx950 only. gfx942 does not take the path, because the AITER kernel targets gfx950 only.
- TP8 only; no other TP size measured.
- Not exercised: NIAH at long context, MTP / speculative decoding. No other model takes the path.
- CUDA: shared code changes are limited to the optional `PrequantizedQKV` argument of `unified_attention` and one entry in the default piecewise CUDA graph splitting ops; a graph that never calls that op splits exactly as before. `test_unified_attention_standard_path_is_unchanged` covers the path without the bundle.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import attention as attention_module
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import PrequantizedQKV
+
+
+def _make_tensors():
+    query = torch.randn(2, 4, 8)
+    key = torch.randn(2, 1, 8)
+    value = torch.randn(2, 1, 8)
+    query_descale = torch.randn(2, 1)
+    key_descale = torch.randn(2, 1)
+    value_descale = torch.randn(2, 1)
+    return (
+        query,
+        key,
+        value,
+        query_descale,
+        key_descale,
+        value_descale,
+    )
+
+
+def test_make_prequantized_qkv_requires_all_tensors():
+    assert (
+        attention_module._make_prequantized_qkv(None, None, None, None, None, None)
+        is None
+    )
+
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="requires query, key, value"):
+        attention_module._make_prequantized_qkv(
+            tensors[0],
+            tensors[1],
+            tensors[2],
+            tensors[3],
+            tensors[4],
+            None,
+        )
+
+
+def test_make_prequantized_qkv_preserves_tensor_identity():
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+    result = attention_module._make_prequantized_qkv(*tensors)
+
+    assert isinstance(result, PrequantizedQKV)
+    assert result is not None
+    assert all(actual is expected for actual, expected in zip(result, tensors))
+
+
+class _RecordingAttentionImpl:
+    def __init__(self, supports_prequantized_qkv_input: bool):
+        self.supports_prequantized_qkv_input = supports_prequantized_qkv_input
+        self.standard_calls = 0
+        self.prequantized_calls = 0
+        self.received_prequantized_qkv: PrequantizedQKV | None = None
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        self.standard_calls += 1
+
+    def forward_with_prequantized_qkv(
+        self, *args, prequantized_qkv: PrequantizedQKV, **kwargs
+    ):
+        self.prequantized_calls += 1
+        self.received_prequantized_qkv = prequantized_qkv
+
+
+def _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl):
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(impl=impl)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        attention_module,
+        "get_attention_context",
+        lambda layer_name: (object(), layer, torch.empty(0), None),
+    )
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_dispatches_prequantized_qkv(monkeypatch):
+    impl = _RecordingAttentionImpl(supports_prequantized_qkv_input=True)
+    _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl)
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+
+    attention_module.unified_attention_with_output(
+        tensors[0],
+        tensors[1],
+        tensors[2],
+        torch.empty_like(tensors[0]),
+        "layer",
+        prequantized_query=tensors[0],
+        prequantized_key=tensors[1],
+        prequantized_value=tensors[2],
+        prequantized_query_descale=tensors[3],
+        prequantized_key_descale=tensors[4],
+        prequantized_value_descale=tensors[5],
+    )
+
+    assert impl.standard_calls == 0
+    assert impl.prequantized_calls == 1
+    assert impl.received_prequantized_qkv is not None
+    assert all(
+        actual is expected
+        for actual, expected in zip(impl.received_prequantized_qkv, tensors)
+    )
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_custom_op_schema_has_prequantized_qkv():
+    schema = str(torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output.default._schema)
+
+    for argument in (
+        "prequantized_query",
+        "prequantized_key",
+        "prequantized_value",
+        "prequantized_query_descale",
+        "prequantized_key_descale",
+        "prequantized_value_descale",
+    ):
+        assert f"Tensor? {argument}=None" in schema
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_rejects_unsupported_prequantized_qkv(monkeypatch):
+    impl = _RecordingAttentionImpl(supports_prequantized_qkv_input=False)
+    _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl)
+    tensors = _make_tensors()
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not support prequantized QKV"):
+        attention_module.unified_attention_with_output(
+            tensors[0],
+            tensors[1],
+            tensors[2],
+            torch.empty_like(tensors[0]),
+            "layer",
+            prequantized_query=tensors[0],
+            prequantized_key=tensors[1],
+            prequantized_value=tensors[2],
+            prequantized_query_descale=tensors[3],
+            prequantized_key_descale=tensors[4],
+            prequantized_value_descale=tensors[5],
+        )
+
+    assert impl.standard_calls == 0
+    assert impl.prequantized_calls == 0
+
+
+def test_unified_attention_standard_path_is_unchanged(monkeypatch):
+    impl = _RecordingAttentionImpl(supports_prequantized_qkv_input=False)
+    _patch_attention_context(monkeypatch, impl)
+    query, key, value, *_ = _make_tensors()
+
+    attention_module.unified_attention_with_output(
+        query,
+        key,
+        value,
+        torch.empty_like(query),
+        "layer",
+    )
+
+    assert impl.standard_calls == 1
+    assert impl.prequantized_calls == 0

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers import (
+    fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant as prep_module,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import attention as attention_module
+from vllm.model_executor.models import qwen3_next as qwen3_next_model
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import PrequantizedQKV
+
+NUM_QUERY_HEADS = 8
+NUM_KV_HEADS = 1
+HEAD_DIM = 256
+ROTARY_DIM = 64
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("max_num_seqs", "expected"),
+    [
+        (256, True),
+        (257, False),
+        (None, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_supports_prequantized_scheduler(
+    max_num_seqs,
+    expected,
+):
+    assert prep_module.supports_prequantized_scheduler(max_num_seqs) is expected
+
+
+def test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_is_cudagraph_unsafe():
+    op = torch.ops.vllm.fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant.default
+    assert torch.Tag.cudagraph_unsafe in op.tags
+
+
+def _make_inputs(tokens: int = 8):
+    q_gate = torch.randn(tokens, NUM_QUERY_HEADS * 2 * HEAD_DIM)
+    key = torch.randn(tokens, NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM)
+    value = torch.randn_like(key)
+    query_norm_weight = torch.randn(HEAD_DIM)
+    key_norm_weight = torch.randn(HEAD_DIM)
+    cos_sin_cache = torch.randn(tokens, ROTARY_DIM)
+    positions = torch.arange(tokens)
+    return (
+        q_gate,
+        key,
+        value,
+        query_norm_weight,
+        key_norm_weight,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        positions,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_outputs(inputs):
+    q_gate, key, value, *_ = inputs
+    tokens = q_gate.shape[0]
+    query = torch.randn(tokens, NUM_QUERY_HEADS * HEAD_DIM)
+    output_key = torch.randn_like(key)
+    gate = torch.randn_like(query)
+    query_fp8 = torch.zeros(
+        tokens,
+        NUM_QUERY_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        device=q_gate.device,
+    )
+    key_fp8 = torch.zeros(
+        tokens,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        device=key.device,
+    )
+    value_fp8 = torch.zeros_like(key_fp8)
+    query_descale = torch.randn(256, NUM_KV_HEADS, device=q_gate.device)
+    key_descale = torch.randn_like(query_descale)
+    value_descale = torch.randn_like(query_descale)
+    return (
+        query,
+        output_key,
+        gate,
+        query_fp8,
+        key_fp8,
+        value_fp8,
+        query_descale,
+        key_descale,
+        value_descale,
+    )
+
+
+def _run_impl(inputs, outputs) -> None:
+    prep_module._fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_impl(
+        inputs[0],
+        inputs[1],
+        inputs[2],
+        inputs[3],
+        inputs[4],
+        inputs[5],
+        inputs[6],
+        "layer",
+        1.0e-6,
+        NUM_QUERY_HEADS,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        ROTARY_DIM,
+        *outputs,
+    )
+
+
+def test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_translates_attention_metadata(monkeypatch):
+    inputs = _make_inputs()
+    expected_outputs = _make_outputs(inputs)
+    query_start_loc = torch.tensor([0, 1, 7], dtype=torch.int32)
+    metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_actual_tokens=7,
+        query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+        num_decodes=1,
+        num_decode_tokens=1,
+        num_extends=1,
+        num_prefills=0,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        attention_module,
+        "get_attention_context",
+        lambda layer_name: (metadata, None, None, None),
+    )
+    recorded_kwargs = None
+
+    def fake_aiter_prep(*args, **kwargs):
+        nonlocal recorded_kwargs
+        recorded_kwargs = kwargs
+        for name, source in zip(
+            (
+                "query_out",
+                "key_out",
+                "gate_out",
+                "query_fp8_out",
+                "key_fp8_out",
+                "value_fp8_out",
+                "query_descale_out",
+                "key_descale_out",
+                "value_descale_out",
+            ),
+            expected_outputs,
+        ):
+            kwargs[name].copy_(source)
+        return expected_outputs
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        prep_module.rocm_aiter_ops,
+        "fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant",
+        fake_aiter_prep,
+    )
+
+    actual_outputs = _make_outputs(inputs)
+    _run_impl(inputs, actual_outputs)
+
+    for actual, expected in zip(actual_outputs, expected_outputs):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+    assert recorded_kwargs is not None
+    assert recorded_kwargs["num_actual_tokens"] == 7
+    assert recorded_kwargs["quant_token_start"] == 1
+    assert recorded_kwargs["quant_sequence_start"] == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA graph support")
+def test_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate_fp8_quant_without_metadata_is_cuda_graph_safe(
+    monkeypatch,
+):
+    inputs = tuple(tensor.to(device="cuda") for tensor in _make_inputs())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        attention_module,
+        "get_attention_context",
+        lambda layer_name: (None, None, None, None),
+    )
+    recorded_cu_seqlens = None
+    outputs = _make_outputs(inputs)
+    expected_outputs = _make_outputs(inputs)
+

Major issue AI found out after removing the gating env variable:
> The backend and the model decide separately whether the FP8 path is on.
> - Backend: the builder makes the chunked-prefill context workspace FP8 if every layer's impl is capable: gfx950, head size 256, FP8 KV cache (rocm_aiter_fa.py:477-508).
> - Model: it sends FP8 Q/K/V only if it opts in: the exact Qwen3.8-2.4T config, text-only, max_num_seqs ≤ 256 (qwen3_next.py:421-430).
> 
> The removed env flag used to keep the two in sync. Now, whenever a layer is capable but the model declines, extend_forward gathers cached K/V into the FP8 workspace and calls CK with a BF16 query and FP8 K/V. CK rejects that on the first batch with cached context (a chunked prefill or a prefix hit).
> 
> That covers:
> - the target model with the default max_num_seqs (1024 on MI355X, which includes the description's serve command);
> - other Qwen3.5/3.8/Qwen3-Next models with FP8 KV on ROCM_AITER_FA.
> 
> Suggested fix: Let the builder follow the model's decision:
> 
> ```
> # attention.py, Attention.__init__
> self.uses_prequantized_qkv = False
> # qwen3_next.py, after computing use_prequantized_qkv
> self.attn.uses_prequantized_qkv = self.use_prequantized_qkv
> # rocm_aiter_fa.py:477
> supports_prequantized_qkv &= layer.uses_prequantized_qkv
> ```
> Optional: in extend_forward, raise a clear error if the workspace is FP8 and prequantized_qkv is None.
> 
> The model is built before the builder, so the flag is always set in time, and every other model keeps the BF16 workspace. Add a builder test: capable impl plus FP8 KV, but the model hasn't opted in, so the workspace is BF16. Optionally, raise a clear error in extend_forward if the workspace is FP8 and no prequantized Q/K/V were passed.
